topic: how to lock a debit card in the chase app

steps.instruction: Open your chase app and sign in.
steps.label: Sign in screen

steps.instruction: On the home screen, tap your TOTAL CHECKING account, the checking account your debit card is tied to.
steps.label: Home dashboard, accounts list

steps.instruction: Scroll down and tap "Manage account" to open your account tools.
steps.label: TOTAL CHECKING account screen

steps.instruction: At the top of the Manage account screen, tap "Lock & unlock card".
steps.label: Manage account screen

steps.instruction: Read the "Misplaced your card?" info. Locking blocks new purchases and ATM withdrawals, but it won't block fees, credits, digital wallet purchases or repeating transactions.
steps.label: Lock & unlock your card screen

steps.instruction: Next to your DEBIT/ATM CARD, tap the blue "Lock card" button.
steps.label: Lock & unlock your card screen

steps.instruction: The green "You've locked your card." message confirms your card is locked, and the button now reads "Unlock card".
steps.label: Card locked confirmation

steps.instruction: When you find your card, come back to this screen and tap "Unlock card" to use it again.
steps.label: Card locked confirmation
